method: Approximate common physical scale using published charger-body height references and visible vertical body edges; photographs retain differing perspectives. AC prongs are retained but excluded from body-height calibration.

adapters.source_basis: Teardown describes the A1265 Apple 5 W housing as inch-cube; MD810 listing maps A1265/A1385. Family-level approximate reference, not an exact caliper measurement of the photographed A1385.
Retailer identifies A2305 body 41 x 40 x 27 mm excluding plug; model mapping includes MWVV3AM/A. Regional SKU differs but model matches; approximate comparison.
ChargerLAB measures A3607 body 95.68 x 74.35 x 28.51 mm and explicitly states the main body and dimensions are identical to the earlier A2452 represented by MKFQ4.
